svg.text: CapFinch synthetic dataset — entity relationship diagram
one row per sale, both channels
one row per product per order
the catalog, one row per SKU

Cardinality is read at each line end. Orange fields are nullable. Note customer_id on orders: ~68% of in-store and ~12% of online orders have none, so an inner join to customers drops most in-store revenue.
Shipping fields on orders are a snapshot taken at order time, not a join to the customer’s current address. Sessions and events exist for online orders only.
